design.reference: head: shaped reference a_r of design_fb.json on [0, T_xi), -a_b until v_r = 0; followers: constants only, desired clearance d_s,i from takeover (sim_bench_hr on a shaped setup)

t_loss_scaling.choice: 15, 30, 60, 90, 120, 140 s (brief) and 145 s = 84 s x T_xi / T_xi,previous, the instant shortly before T_xi

scenario.loss: every link fails at the first grid instant at or after t_loss; every receiver sets its held command to zero and keeps its flags and mode; no message or flag is delivered afterwards
scenario.emergency: unit 3 applies -amax_3 = -1.38 m/s^2 from the loss instant until it rests (laws, filter and input set bypassed)
scenario.watchdog: a follower that has received no packet for T_wd applies -amax_i until it rests (arrival aborted)
scenario.completion: every unit stopped, no contact, no override (no watchdog braking, no emergency braking)
